items.title: OpenAI opens GPT-Rosalind Academic Plan for research labs
items.summary_en: OpenAI announced a program giving eligible academic labs sponsored access to GPT-Rosalind, its life-sciences model. Applications were reported open for labs at U.S. universities.

items.title: OpenAI shares AI progress on open math problems; $5M for Simons Foundation initiative
items.summary_en: OpenAI's post reports new results on open mathematics problems from an internal model. It also reportedly commits $5 million to a Simons Foundation initiative supporting mathematicians.
